column1: # The Debian ordering as a real dpkg answers it.
# Captured 2026-11-08 from dpkg 1.22.22 on Debian GNU/Linux 13 (trixie),
# x86_64, by putting `lt`, `eq` and `gt` to `dpkg --compare-versions` for
# each pair and recording which one held. Not written from the policy
# manual: the manual is what the table in vercmp_test.go was already
# built from, and a fixture written from the same document would test the
# document twice.
# dpkg warned about none of these: every version here begins with a
# digit, so all 25 are inside Debian policy.
# A second dpkg has since agreed: 1.21.23 on amd64, in the bookworm
# container of the `debian` fleet leg, answered all 25 the same way
# (`TestLiveDpkgVersionCmpAgreesWithDpkg`, Fleet run 42518184078).
# One line per pair: first version, the relation that held, second
# version. `vercmp_fixture_test.go` holds this file and `debianVectors`
# to each other in both directions, so a vector with no captured answer
# fails as loudly as a captured answer for a vector that has gone.
# DIVERGENCE 5.633.
